items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: On the violin while I was working for them. I was working for him every Sunday night.

ctx.x: On the violin while I was working for them. I was working for him every Sunday night. Sometime through the week, because I know how many bands would come in town. And sometime I'd sit in there, Louis Armstrong would come in town. I'd sit in and work with him. Well, they didn't give me anything, but I imagined that they would give him all. Well, I said what it was. It didn't make anything to me. I was too glad to say that I was working with Louis Armstrong to receive anything. You understand? Yeah. And I still was…
Did you have the San Jacinto then?
